summary: Feed s102_single is degraded due to high encrypted share (93.7% vs 90% NDR tolerance) limiting payload inspection. All other checks (duplicates, missing VLAN, one-way, packet drops, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Traffic is 93.7% encrypted bytes, exceeding the NDR's 90% tolerance. Packet broker is forwarding TLS sessions as-is with no decryption or key forwarding, so payload remains opaque to the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires full payload for signature and behavioral detection. With ~94% of bytes encrypted, the NDR is blind to most payloads, significantly reducing detection coverage and increasing missed threats.

recommended_fix.why: Selective TLS decryption or key forwarding at the packet broker will restore cleartext payload to the NDR, bringing encrypted share below 90% and improving detection coverage without changing TAP/SPAN.
